title: An empty change directory left by a branch switch is not an open native change (148)
description: An empty change directory left by a branch switch is not an open native change (148)
no_spec_change_rationale: Issue #148: Chough counted any directory under .specsync/changes as an open change, so an empty one left by a branch switch broke the index check and could refuse the trim; no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: A directory under .specsync/changes with no file at any depth is not an open change: the knowledge index does not list it and the trim does not refuse on it, while a directory with a change file still counts as open; the new test fails first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Issue #148 (ch-c456); orc queue order: #148 next; REQ-cli-043 and the open-change refusal kept for real changes.
